data.name: Cli_Help
data.value:
XamlNexus - Windows desktop prototype scaffolding / XamlNexus - Windows 桌面原型脚手架
Quick start: / 快速开始 xamlnexus new MyApp cd MyApp xamlnexus run Stop with Ctrl+C before editing or running again. / 修改或再次运行前，按 Ctrl+C 停止当前运行。 Edit MyApp.MainPanel/MainPage.xaml and ViewModels/MainViewModel.cs. / 编辑 MainPage.xaml 及其 ViewModel。 xamlnexus page add Workspace xamlnexus run After stopping: xamlnexus add sqlite, then xamlnexus run. / 停止后，可添加 sqlite，再运行项目。
Usage: / 命令用法 xamlnexus Start interactive mode / 启动交互模式 xamlnexus new <name> [options] Create a project / 创建项目 xamlnexus page add <name> [--project <directory>] [--no-navigation] [--dry-run] [--json] 添加页面；--no-navigation 跳过导航注册。 / Add a page; --no-navigation skips navigation registration. xamlnexus run [path] [--project <directory>] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--json] Build and run Debug/x64 unpackaged; Ctrl+C stops this run. / 构建并运行 Debug/x64 非打包应用，Ctrl+C 停止运行。 --no-build uses existing output; no watch or hot reload. / --no-build 使用已有构建产物；不提供文件监听或热重载。 xamlnexus list [path] [--json] List project capabilities / 列出项目已安装的能力 xamlnexus validate [path] [--json] Validate the manifest and managed files / 检查项目清单和受管理文件 xamlnexus doctor [path] [--json] Diagnose environment and project health / 诊断环境和项目状态 xamlnexus upgrade [path] [options] Upgrade scaffold-managed infrastructure / 升级脚手架管理的基础代码 xamlnexus recipes [--json] List built-in Recipes / 列出可添加的内置组件 xamlnexus add <recipe[,recipe...]> [options] Install Recipes transactionally / 通过事务添加组件 xamlnexus remove <recipe> [options] Remove a Recipe transactionally / 通过事务移除组件 xamlnexus update <recipe> [options] Update a Recipe transactionally / 通过事务更新组件 xamlnexus --help Show help / 显示帮助（也可使用 help、-h、-?） xamlnexus --version Show version / 显示版本
New options: / 创建项目参数 -n, --name <name> Project name (or use the positional name) / 项目名称，也可直接写在 new 后 -p, --preset <preset> winui (default) or hybrid / winui（默认）或 hybrid -o, --output <directory> Parent output directory (default: current directory) / 输出父目录，默认为当前目录 --profile <standard|basic> Starting capability profile (default: standard) / 初始能力组合，默认为 standard basic omits the full settings panel; core services remain. / basic 不包含完整设置面板，保留核心服务。 --features <ids> Install comma-separated Recipes during creation / 创建时添加组件，多个 ID 用逗号分隔 -l, --language <language> zh-CN (default) or en-US / 生成应用的语言：zh-CN（默认）或 en-US -f, --solution-format <format> sln (default) or slnx / sln（默认）或 slnx
Project command options: / 项目命令参数 -p, --project <path> Project directory or xamlnexus.json path / 项目目录或 xamlnexus.json 路径 --dry-run Validate and show changes without writing files / 检查并预览变更，不写入项目文件 --json Emit machine-readable query or change output / 以 JSON 输出查询或变更结果 --resolve-from <directory> Apply manually resolved upgrade .merge files / 应用手动解决冲突后的升级 .merge 文件 --conflict-output <directory> Export upgrade merge conflicts (writes files) / 导出升级冲突文件，此选项会写入文件
Examples: / 示例 xamlnexus new MyApp xamlnexus new MinimalApp --profile basic xamlnexus new DataApp --profile basic --features settings,sqlite xamlnexus run --project MyApp xamlnexus page add Workspace --project MyApp --dry-run xamlnexus new MyApp --preset hybrid --output D:\Projects --language en-US xamlnexus list D:\Projects\MyApp xamlnexus validate --project D:\Projects\MyApp --json xamlnexus doctor --project D:\Projects\MyApp --json xamlnexus upgrade --project D:\Projects\MyApp --dry-run --json xamlnexus upgrade --project D:\Projects\MyApp --conflict-output .\upgrade-conflicts xamlnexus recipes xamlnexus add editorconfig --project D:\Projects\MyApp --dry-run xamlnexus remove editorconfig --project D:\Projects\MyApp xamlnexus update sqlite --project D:\Projects\MyApp
Recipes: settings, sqlite, system-tray, app-update, editorconfig. / 可用组件：设置、SQLite、系统托盘、应用更新、编辑器配置。 standard includes settings; hybrid includes tray and updater. / standard 包含设置；hybrid 包含托盘和更新能力。 app-update depends on settings. Do not add already installed Recipes. / app-update 依赖 settings；不要重复添加已安装组件。 Guide: https://github.com/PaperHammer/XamlNexus/blob/main/docs/user-guide/quickstart.zh-CN.md
